main_text.p: סַלָּק Chald. Ascendit. Prat. f. סְלֶקֶת Ascen-debat, Succrescebat, Dan.7.8: סְלִיקוּ. Ascenderunt, Esr.4.14. Part. plur. fœm.

סָמַךְ Niti, Inniti, Incumbere, & sic construitur cum עַל: Imponere, Fulcire, Sustentare, confl. cum Acc. item Accedere, Appropinquare, & sic cum Præp. אֶל. Niphal נִסְמַךְ Inniti. Pihel סִמֵּךְ Fulcire.
סָמַר Horrere, Rigere, Horridum esse. Pihel סִמֵּר Horrere facere.
מִסְמְרִים מִסְמְרִים m. p. Clavi. Et fœmin. מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִסְמֶרֶת, item cum Sin, מִשְׁמֶרֶת.
סַנְסַן m. Ramus, Palmes: plur. סַנְסַנִּים.
סַס m. Tinea, Blatta, qua Græcè dicitur σής, Matth.6.19: Syrè סָּסָא.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and several Hebrew words are faint and partly damaged by stains; readings of the Hebrew forms are approximate. The Greek word σής and the Hebrew entries are reproduced as far as legible.
